name: Aqaba
tagline: Red Sea reefs at Jordan's only port
summary: Aqaba is Jordan's Red Sea town, with coral reefs a short swim from the beach. Snorkel or dive the Japanese Garden and a sunken tank, see the fort Lawrence of Arabia captured, eat fish sayadieh by the sea and use it as an easy base for Wadi Rum and Petra.
seasonNote: Warm sea all year; summer is very hot.
arrival: King Hussein airport has flights; buses from Amman take 4 hours; Wadi Rum is 1 hour away.
gettingAround: Taxis; the South Beach is 10 to 15 km south of town.
cashTip: Carry dinars for taxis and small shops; cards work in hotels. Tip about 10 percent.
foodTip: Sayadieh (spiced fish and rice), fresh grilled fish and knafeh.
buyTip: Dead Sea products tax-free (Aqaba is a special economic zone).
baseArea: Town centre or South Beach for diving
